description: Sandbox release-candidate validation coverage register (tempdoc 728, Part B/C). Projection-not-fork applied to release validation: what a clean-Sandbox round must verify DERIVES from what the app ships, instead of being remembered. scripts/sandbox/gen_coverage_brief.py reads the committed surface artifacts (route-manifest cohorts, CorePlugin.ts surface ids, coreInteractionShapes.ts) and FAILS CLOSED if any derived cohort/surface/shape is neither covered nor exempted here — so a newly-shipped surface (the /mcp and trust-panel misses that motivated this doc) can no longer be silently forgotten. Tiers: 'sandbox' = the clean-install / real-GUI / real-external-agent view only the Sandbox has; 'host' = protocol/contract correctness a host test already owns (the Sandbox still confirms reachability); 'sandbox-must-watch' = findings that cannot be CI-gated (Windows trust prompts) and are re-injected into every round's brief (Part C). Same positive-coverage shape as check-ui-step-coverage / check-declared-surfaces.

cohortCoverage.validateHow: On a clean install, confirm an EXTERNAL MCP client reaches POST /mcp: `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp --transport http --method tools/list` returns the tool set. requiredRoutes pins POST /mcp so a token-only GET can't satisfy coverage. Protocol conformance is host-owned (StdioMcpTransportIntegrationTest); the Sandbox proves clean-install reachability + discoverability.
Search + ingest journeys: add a folder / ingest SciFact via the UI, run real searches, compare UI results to /api/knowledge/* responses.
Library indexing journey: per-folder row state, Tasks panel live updates, status-bar queue agree with /api/knowledge/status during ingest.
One idle chat completion at GPU speed; runtime selects cuda12; /api/inference/status truthful.
Install AI journey: full model + cuda-runtime download reaches installedFully; /api/ai/runtime/status truthful.
Chat/RAG: grounded cited answer; escalation-ladder rungs honest (see shapeCoverage).
The one interaction surface renders; mode labels match the actual response.
The Agent 'delegate a task' rung makes obvious what it will do before it runs; disabled with a clear reason when AI is offline.
An external client can call /v1 chat completions on a clean install (loopback).

mustWatch.reason: SmartScreen / Defender / Smart App Control / unsigned-publisher warnings on install cannot be reproduced in CI (no clean Windows); every round records the exact prompt text/screenshots and whether automation (/S) was honored.
Shell showing 'Reconnecting...' or stale cards while /api/health, /api/status, /api/knowledge/status are READY is a clean-environment/timing finding CI cannot see; must-watch on every round.
